Immich | High-performance photo and video backup, a Google Photos alternative

summary.one_liner: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video management application with mobile and web clients, positioned as a high-performance alternative to Google Photos.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a self-hosted photo and video management solution with automatic backup from the mobile app and a web interface. Supported features include uploading and viewing photos and videos, duplicate prevention, selective album backup, multi-user support, albums and shared albums, partner and public sharing, and archive and favorites. Search covers metadata, objects, faces and CLIP, with facial recognition and clustering, a global map, and EXIF metadata view. It also handles raw formats, LivePhoto/MotionPhoto backup and playback, stacked photos, folder view, API keys, and OAuth login. Full installation and documentation are hosted externally and are not covered in the README itself.
use_cases: replace Google Photos with a private alternative
organize and search personal photo library by faces and objects
browse and back up raw photo and video files
view photos on a map by location
how_to_run: Follow the installation guide in the main Immich documentation (linked externally from the README)
notable: Mobile and web feature parity for many functions, with a feature matrix in the README
Facial recognition, object and CLIP-based search
Live Photo and Motion Photo backup and playback
Partner sharing and public sharing links
caveats: Background backup and offline support are mobile-only; some features such as admin functions and tags are web-only
README warns users to follow a 3-2-1 backup plan for their photos
Installation details are in external documentation, not the README
